verdict.rationale: OpenHands accepts plain-language tasks in the CLI and works toward a stated goal (`/goal`-style objectives), so the natural-language intake is documented. Turning that description into an explicitly scoped implementation task is only implied: a planning agent appears as a custom-agent example in the SDK, and the issue-triage automation gathers context and routes issues rather than producing an implementation spec. missing for 10: a documented built-in step that converts a feature or bug description into a scoped task or spec, a shown example of that planning output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
